t: Malta Public Transport announces special services for Birgufest
html:
Malta Public Transport will be operating special and additional services for Birgufest on Saturday, 11 October 2025, including night trips to faciliate access to this cultural and historical event.

To meet the higher demand expected during this evening, Malta Public Transport is adding four additional trips on Route 2 between Valletta and Birgu, thereby increasing the route’s frequency between 8.45pm and 10.55pm.

It is also operating a special S10 service linking the Café Riche stop in Birgu to Valletta between 11.20pm and 1am.

Tallinja Card holders can travel free of charge, while cash or contactless tickets cost €2.50 on Route 2 and €3.00 on the S10.

Passengers can find full route details and schedules on the Malta Public Transport website, Tallinja App and social media channels.
